original_keep_mapping.actual_matcher_not_rerun: Reuse audited original keep group0; map its surviving pixels to full-core, nonoverlap annotation boxes.

aggregation: One vote per unique exposed target index / fixed reliable object / unique hard-background ROI. Overlapping segment repeats deduplicated for diagnostics; different input windows remain separate contextual observations. Training losses and their multiplicity are unchanged.

definitions.weak_logit: mean original bbox-mean logits on release-weak exposed targets
definitions.weak_margin: mean(q_positive - q_negative), q_negative=max valid local/global ROI means
definitions.hardbg_logit: mean ROI-mean logit over unique original hard-background ROIs attached to all exposed targets
definitions.reliable_logit: mean bbox-mean logit over original keep reliable annotation objects
definitions.reliable_score: mean within-bbox peak probability over those same fixed objects
definitions.reliable_peak_xy: fixed-bbox peak pixel centers; row-major tie; not full detector component localization
definitions.keep_target_mse: mean squared probability error on all original keep group0 pixels (pooled pixels; diagnostic only)
definitions.weak_fixed_release_peak_logit: mean logit at fixed release-selected bbox peak coordinates; extra diagnostic
